content_sections.heading: AIIMS New Delhi Senior Research Fellow Eligibility Criteria

rows.qualification_required: B.A.M.S. in Ayurveda. Desirable: Preference will be given to candidates who have qualified the AYUSH NET examination and have previous research experience, particularly in research projects funded by the Ministry of AYUSH, ICMR, CSIR, DST, or any equivalent organization; skills of drafting editing of scientific documents/articles/technical reports etc.; publication in peer reviewed journals; working knowledge of computer applications.
MSc (Life Sciences) with 2 years research experience or MBBS/BDS/MVSc/M.Pharma/ME/M.Tech degree holders. Desirable: Knowledge and experience of clinical trials, systematic reviews and meta-analysis.

1. Intermediate or 12th pass from recognized board. And 2. Any diploma/course of Computer, And 3. 2 years' experience in data entry work. Desirable: 1. Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a govt. recognized university with diploma in computer application. 2. Should have good typing speed in English and Hindi.

faq.question: Q1. What is the AIIMS New Delhi Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by the Department of Plastic, Reconstructive & Burns Surgery, AIIMS New Delhi, for hiring 3 contractual positions under a research project.

faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies distributed across Senior Research Fellow (Ayurveda, Medical), Senior Research Fellow (Non-Medical), and Data Entry Operator posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to fill out the Google form for application is 21 October 2026 up to 5:30 PM.

faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.A.M.S. degree in Ayurveda.
